Load packages.

```{r}
library(sf)
library(stringr)
library(rfishbase)
library(readr)
library(readxl)
library(fastDummies)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(rgbif)
```

All source data are downloaded from the web on first run and cached in data_raw/, so later runs don't download them again. Delete a file in data_raw/ to force a fresh download. The largest file (BasinATLAS, ~2.5 GB) can take a while.

```{r}
data_dir <- "data_raw"
dir.create(data_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
options(timeout = 3600) # allow long downloads

# download url to data_raw/file unless it is already there; return the local path
fetch <- function(url, file) {
  dest <- file.path(data_dir, file)
  if (!file.exists(dest)) download.file(url, dest, mode = "wb")
  dest
}
```

Taxonomic name harmonization. Fish names are updated to the current FishBase valid name: accepted names stay, synonyms map to their valid name, and misapplied/ambiguous names or names FishBase doesn't know (e.g. "Genus sp") are left unchanged. FishBase is used rather than the GBIF backbone because GBIF lags for fish (e.g. it still sinks Psalidodon and Megaleporinus into Astyanax and Leporinus). Non-fish taxa are updated to the GBIF accepted species, only where GBIF matches the name at species level.

```{r}
# every adjustment below records its counts here; written to adjustments_summary.csv at the end
adjustments <- data.frame(step = character(), source = character(), measure = character(), value = numeric())
log_adj <- function(step, source, measure, value) {
  adjustments <<- rbind(adjustments, data.frame(step = step, source = source, measure = measure, value = value))
}

# record how many names and rows a name update changed
log_names <- function(step, source, old, new) {
  log_adj(step, source, "unique names checked", length(unique(na.omit(old))))
  log_adj(step, source, "unique names changed", length(unique(old[which(old != new)])))
  log_adj(step, source, "rows changed", sum(old != new, na.rm = TRUE))
}

# record rows removed by de-duplicating after a name update
log_dups <- function(source, before, after) {
  log_adj("Duplicates removed after name update", source, "rows removed", before - after)
}

# FishBase valid name for each fish name in x; pass source to log the changes
fb_valid <- function(x, source = NULL) {
  syn <- synonyms(unique(na.omit(x)))
  lk <- syn %>%
    filter(Status %in% c("accepted name", "provisionally accepted name", "synonym"),
           Species != "To be entered") %>%  # valid names FishBase has no species record for yet (SpecCode 0)
    mutate(accepted = Status != "synonym") %>%
    group_by(synonym) %>%
    filter(if (any(accepted)) accepted else n_distinct(Species) == 1) %>%  # skip synonyms of >1 species
    summarise(Species = first(Species))
  out <- coalesce(lk$Species[match(x, lk$synonym)], x)
  if (!is.null(source)) {
    step <- "Name update (FishBase)"
    log_names(step, source, x, out)
    log_adj(step, source, "names kept: accepted but no FishBase species record yet",
            length(setdiff(syn$synonym[syn$Species %in% "To be entered"], lk$synonym)))
    log_adj(step, source, "names kept: not found in FishBase",
            length(setdiff(unique(na.omit(x)), syn$synonym[!is.na(syn$Status)])))
  }
  out
}

# FishBase family for each (already valid) species name; keep the original family where FishBase has none
fb_family <- function(species, family, source = NULL) {
  taxa <- load_taxa()
  out <- coalesce(taxa$Family[match(species, taxa$Species)], family)
  if (!is.null(source)) log_adj("Family update (FishBase)", source, "rows changed", sum(out != family, na.rm = TRUE))
  out
}

# GBIF accepted species for each non-fish name in x; pass source to log the changes
gbif_valid <- function(x, source = NULL) {
  res <- name_backbone_checklist(unique(na.omit(x)))
  ok <- res$matchType %in% c("EXACT", "VARIANT", "FUZZY") & res$rank %in% c("SPECIES", "SUBSPECIES") & !is.na(res$species)
  out <- coalesce(res$species[ok][match(x, res$verbatim_name[ok])], x)
  if (!is.null(source)) log_names("Name update (GBIF)", source, x, out)
  out
}
```

From the IsoFresh database:
Boulêtreau, S., Vagnon, C., Comte, L., Sagouis, A., Pool, T., Stiling, R.R., Harrod, C., South, J., McIntosh, A.R., Perga, M.E. and Sánchez-Hernández, J., 2025. IsoFresh: A global stable isotope database of freshwater food webs. Knowledge & Management of Aquatic Ecosystems, (426), p.15. https://www.kmae-journal.org/articles/kmae/full_html/2025/01/kmae250024/kmae250024.html

Data: https://zenodo.org/records/14982323. The files are semicolon-delimited.

```{r}
isofresh_url <- "https://zenodo.org/api/records/14982323/files/"
read_isofresh <- function(name) {
  path <- fetch(paste0(isofresh_url, name, "/content"), name)
  read.csv(path, sep = ";", fileEncoding = "UTF-8-BOM")
}
```

Bring in fish species with isotopic data from this database.

```{r}
fish <- read_isofresh("IsoFresh_Isotope_Fish.csv")
```

Bring in ecosystem data from the same database which includes coordinates. The Zenodo version already includes the coordinates for ID_0877 (041_Rémarde) that were missing earlier.

```{r}
eco <- read_isofresh("IsoFresh_Ecosystem.csv")
eco <- eco[which(!is.na(eco$Longitude)),]
```

Join fish observations to ecosystem and point location using FoodWeb_ID as the join field.

```{r}
fish_eco <- merge(fish, eco, by = "FoodWeb_ID", all.x = TRUE)
```

Convert fish_eco to an sf object.

```{r}
f_sf <- st_as_sf(fish_eco, coords = c("Longitude", "Latitude"), crs = 4326, remove = FALSE)
```

Update IsoFresh fish names and families to FishBase.

```{r}
f_sf$Scientific_name <- fb_valid(f_sf$Scientific_name, "IsoFresh fish")
f_sf$Family <- fb_family(f_sf$Scientific_name, f_sf$Family, "IsoFresh fish")
```

From SInAS database:
Gómez-Suárez, M., Laeseke, P. & Seebens, H. A global dataset of native and alien distributions of alien species. Sci Data 12, 1914 (2025). https://doi.org/10.1038/s41597-025-06379-6

Data: SInAS 3.1.1 + geopackage, https://zenodo.org/records/18220953

Get region polygons, which are mostly countries, but at least one body of water.

```{r}
sinas_url <- "https://zenodo.org/api/records/18220953/files/"
gpkg_zip <- fetch(paste0(sinas_url, "SInAS_locations_3.1.gpkg.zip/content"), "SInAS_locations_3.1.gpkg.zip")
gpkg <- list.files(data_dir, pattern = "^SInAS_locations.*\\.gpkg$", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)
if (length(gpkg) == 0) {
  unzip(gpkg_zip, exdir = data_dir)
  gpkg <- list.files(data_dir, pattern = "^SInAS_locations.*\\.gpkg$", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)
}
gpkg <- gpkg[1]

# List all layers
st_layers(gpkg)

# Read a specific layer
gdf <- st_read(gpkg, layer = "AllLocations")
gdf <- st_make_valid(gdf)
```

Do spatial join to get country for each of the IsoFresh locations, copy f_sf column Scientific_name to a column called "Taxon", and drop geometry.

```{r}
f_sf <- st_join(f_sf, gdf, join = st_nearest_feature)
f_db <- st_drop_geometry(f_sf)
f_db$Taxon <- f_db$Scientific_name
colnames(f_db)[23] <- "Location"
```

GFID (fish only) (https://jalter.diasjp.net/data/ERDP-2025-06 ; https://esj-journals.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/full/10.1111/1440-1703.70016#)

Data: https://github.com/IsmaSA/GFID (sheet "Overall_data" of GFID.xlsx)

From GFID extract: native_region, First_record for each fish species

```{r}
gfid_xlsx <- fetch("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/IsmaSA/GFID/master/GFID.xlsx", "GFID.xlsx")
gfid <- as.data.frame(read_excel(gfid_xlsx, sheet = "Overall_data"))
```

Update GFID names and families to FishBase.

```{r}
gfid$Taxon <- fb_valid(gfid$Taxon, "GFID")
gfid$Family <- fb_family(gfid$Taxon, gfid$Family, "GFID")
n0 <- nrow(gfid)
gfid <- distinct(gfid) # synonyms collapsing to one name can create duplicate rows
log_dups("GFID", n0, nrow(gfid))
```

Bring in SInAS data on native vs introduced to join to points. The SInAS csv is space-delimited with quoted fields. Also fix labels so that there is only one "uncertain". Also drop not freshwater fish sources to limit to same (sinas_sources.csv is our own list of which SInAS datasets to keep).

```{r}
sinas_csv <- fetch(paste0(sinas_url, "SInAS_3.1.1.csv/content"), "SInAS_3.1.1.csv")
sinas <- read.table(sinas_csv, header = TRUE, sep = " ", quote = "\"", comment.char = "",
                    fileEncoding = "UTF-8", na.strings = c("", "NA"))
keep <- read.csv("sinas_sources.csv")

sinas <- merge(sinas, keep, by = "datasetName")
sinas <- subset(sinas, keep == 1)
sinas$keep <- NULL

colnames(sinas)[4] <- "Scientific_name" # to match IsoFresh species column
sinas$establishmentMeans[sinas$establishmentMeans %in% c("introduced; uncertain", "uncertain;introduced")] <- "uncertain"
```

Drop infraspecific taxa and extra spaces from SInAS data. Also drop taxa with only genus and no species.

```{r}
sinas <- sinas %>%
  mutate(
    Scientific_name = str_squish(Scientific_name),
    Scientific_name = word(Scientific_name, 1, 2)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !str_detect(Scientific_name, "\\bsp\\.?$|\\bspp\\.?$"),   # drop "Genus sp." / "Genus spp."
    str_detect(Scientific_name, "^\\S+\\s+\\S+$")               # keep only two-word names (drop genus-only)
  )
```

Update SInAS names to FishBase.

```{r}
sinas$Scientific_name <- fb_valid(sinas$Scientific_name, "SInAS")
n0 <- nrow(sinas)
sinas <- distinct(sinas) # synonyms collapsing to one name can create duplicate rows
log_dups("SInAS", n0, nrow(sinas))
```

Join SInAS to IsoFresh by "Scientific_name" and "location" columns.

```{r}
f_sfs <- merge(f_sf, sinas, by = c("Scientific_name","location","locationID"))
```

Join f_sfs to gfid.

```{r}
f_dbs <- st_drop_geometry(f_sfs)
f_dbs$Taxon <- f_dbs$Scientific_name
colnames(f_dbs)[2] <- "Location"
f_dbs <- merge(f_dbs, gfid, by = c("Taxon","Location","Family"))
f_dbs$Scientific_name <- NULL
```

Make dummy variable from EstablishmentMeans and remove duplicate rows for the same species/locations with multiple designations for native vs intoduced.

```{r}
f_dbsd <- f_dbs %>%
   dummy_cols(select_columns = "establishmentMeans", remove_selected_columns = TRUE)
```

Get unique Taxon, FoodWeb_Id and establishmentMeans_introduced and establishmentMeans_native

```{r}
f_agg <- f_dbsd %>%
   group_by(Taxon,FoodWeb_ID) %>%
   summarise(
    across(c(establishmentMeans_introduced, establishmentMeans_native), max, na.rm = T)
   )
```

Get unique f_dbsd without establishment dummy columns.

```{r}
f_cols <- unique(f_dbsd[,c(1:31,41)])
```

Join f_agg to f_cols, keeping all fcols.

```{r}
f_cols <- merge(f_cols, f_agg, by = c("Taxon","FoodWeb_ID"), all.x = T)
write.csv(f_cols, "fish_fw_inv.csv", row.names = FALSE, na = "")
```

Create a version without duplicate rows.

```{r}
f_cols_no_dup <- unique(f_cols[,c(1:23,25,27,32:34)])
write.csv(f_cols_no_dup, "fish_fw_inv_no_dup.csv", row.names = FALSE, na = "")
```

Get fish species richness by FoodWeb_ID.

```{r}
f_cols_no_dup$species_richness <- rep(1, nrow(f_cols_no_dup))
fw_sp_richness <- aggregate(species_richness~FoodWeb_ID,data=f_cols_no_dup,sum)
write.csv(fw_sp_richness, "foodweb_species_richness.csv", row.names = FALSE, na = "")
```

From GIATAR, https://www.nature.com/articles/s41597-024-03824-w extract species optimum temperatures from the CABI water tolerances table.

Data: https://zenodo.org/records/15042321 (query functions: https://github.com/ncsu-landscape-dynamics/GIATAR-dataset)

```{r}
giatar_zip <- fetch("https://zenodo.org/api/records/15042321/files/GIATAR.zip/content", "GIATAR.zip")
giatar_files <- c("dataset/species lists/invasive_all_source.csv",
                  "dataset/CABI data/CABI_tables/towaterTolerances.csv")
giatar_dir <- file.path(data_dir, "GIATAR")
if (!all(file.exists(file.path(giatar_dir, giatar_files)))) unzip(giatar_zip, files = giatar_files, exdir = giatar_dir)

sp <- as.data.frame(unique(f_cols_no_dup$Taxon))
colnames(sp)[1] <- "Taxon"

inv <- read_csv(file.path(giatar_dir, giatar_files[1]), col_types = cols(usageKey = col_character()))

inv <-as.data.frame(inv)

# update GIATAR fish names to FishBase so they match Taxon (GBIF leaves ray-finned fish with no class)
is_fish <- inv$phylum %in% "Chordata" & inv$class %in% c(NA, "", "Dipneusti", "Elasmobranchii", "Petromyzonti")
for (col in c("taxonCABI", "canonicalName", "taxonSINAS")) inv[is_fish, col] <- fb_valid(inv[is_fish, col], paste("GIATAR", col))

sp1 <- merge(sp, inv, by.x = "Taxon", by.y = "taxonCABI")
sp1 <- sp1[,c(1,3)]
sp2 <- merge(sp, inv, by.x = "Taxon", by.y = "canonicalName")
sp2 <- sp2[,c(1,4)]
sp3 <- merge(sp, inv, by.x = "Taxon", by.y = "taxonSINAS")
sp3 <- sp3[,c(1,4)]

sp <- rbind(sp1,sp2,sp3)

sp <- unique(sp)

watertol <- read_csv(file.path(giatar_dir, giatar_files[2]), col_types = cols(usageKey = col_character()))
watertol <- as.data.frame(watertol)
watertemp <- subset(watertol, Parameter == "Water temperature (ºC temperature)")

water_temp <- merge(sp, watertol, by = "usageKey", all.x = T)
write.csv(water_temp,"species_water_temp.csv", row.names = FALSE, na = "")
```

Bring in Hydrobasins and extract values to points.

Linke, S. et al. Global hydro-environmental sub-basin and river reach characteristics at high spatial resolution. Sci. Data 6, 283 (2019). Data: https://www.hydrosheds.org/hydroatlas. Only the level 12 BasinATLAS shapefile (BasinATLAS_v10_lev12.shp) is used; it is kept next to this Rmd because the download can't be scripted.

```{r}
basins <- st_read("BasinATLAS_v10_lev12.shp")
basins <- st_make_valid(basins)
f_sfx <- unique(f_sf[,c(1,23,24)])
f_sfx <- st_join(f_sfx, basins, join = st_nearest_feature)
f_sfx <- st_drop_geometry(f_sfx)
write.csv(f_sfx, "fw_hydrobasins.csv", row.names = FALSE, na = "")
```

Tedesco, P. A. et al. A global database on freshwater fish species occurrence in drainage basins. Sci. Data 4, 1–6 (2017). Data: https://doi.org/10.6084/m9.figshare.c.3739145.v1

Liuyong, D. (2026). A global geospatial dataset of freshwater fish species at the drainage-basin scale (updated to December 2024) [Dataset]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.19511163

Bring in Liuyong basins.

```{r}
liuyong_url <- "https://zenodo.org/api/records/19511163/files/"
for (ext in c("shp", "shx", "dbf", "prj")) {
  f <- paste0("Basin_202412_3364.", ext)
  fetch(paste0(liuyong_url, f, "/content"), f)
}
basins2 <- st_read(file.path(data_dir, "Basin_202412_3364.shp"))
basins2 <- st_make_valid(basins2)
```

Bring in Liuyong/Tedesco occurrence data. The Liuyong species list comes as xlsx; keep the columns used here and give them the Tedesco column names. The Tedesco Occurrence_Table is semicolon-delimited and uses "." instead of a space in species names.

```{r}
cas_xlsx <- fetch(paste0(liuyong_url, "cas_freshwater_202412.xlsx/content"), "cas_freshwater_202412.xlsx")
cas <- read_excel(cas_xlsx, sheet = "CAS") %>%
  transmute(X6.Fishbase.Valid.Species.Name = valid_name, class, order, family, X1.Basin.Name = basin) %>%
  as.data.frame()
cas <- separate_longer_delim(cas, cols = X1.Basin.Name, delim = ";")

tedesco_zip <- fetch("https://ndownloader.figshare.com/files/8964583", "Tedesco_2017.zip")
if (!file.exists(file.path(data_dir, "Occurrence_Table.csv"))) unzip(tedesco_zip, files = "Occurrence_Table.csv", exdir = data_dir)
ot <- read.csv(file.path(data_dir, "Occurrence_Table.csv"), sep = ";")
ot$X6.Fishbase.Valid.Species.Name <- gsub(".", " ", ot$X6.Fishbase.Valid.Species.Name, fixed = TRUE)

# both lists use FishBase valid names as of their release; bring them up to the current FishBase
cas$X6.Fishbase.Valid.Species.Name <- fb_valid(cas$X6.Fishbase.Valid.Species.Name, "Liuyong")
ot$X6.Fishbase.Valid.Species.Name <- fb_valid(ot$X6.Fishbase.Valid.Species.Name, "Tedesco")
n0 <- nrow(cas)
cas <- distinct(cas)
log_dups("Liuyong", n0, nrow(cas))
n0 <- nrow(ot)
ot <- distinct(ot)
log_dups("Tedesco", n0, nrow(ot))

cas_ot <- merge(cas,ot, by = c("X6.Fishbase.Valid.Species.Name","X1.Basin.Name"),all.x=T)
```

Join food web locations to Liuyong basins.

```{r}
fw_sf <- st_as_sf(eco, coords = c("Longitude", "Latitude"), crs = 4326, remove = FALSE)
sf_use_s2(FALSE)
fw_sf <- st_join(fw_sf, basins2, join = st_nearest_feature)
sf_use_s2(TRUE)
```

Make table of food webs and Liuyong basins

```{r}
fw_liuyong <- st_drop_geometry(fw_sf)
write.csv(fw_liuyong, "fw_liuyong.csv", row.names = FALSE, na = "")
```

Restrict cas_ot$X1.Basin.Name to just the basins in fw_liuyong.

```{r}
cas_ot <- subset(cas_ot, X1.Basin.Name %in% fw_liuyong$basin)
```

Reduce cas_ot to just the basins that coincide with food webs.

```{r}
cas_ot_fw <- merge(fw_liuyong,cas_ot,by.x="basin",by.y="X1.Basin.Name",all.x=T)
```

Join cas_ot_fw to f_cols_no_dup which has the SiNAS native vs exotic labels based on country. Native/exotic status comes from Tedesco (basin level) first, then SInAS, then FishBase (both country level), then FishBase native records anywhere in the basin ("NativeBasin"), and finally Liuyong's own native-range lists for species FishBase has no record of ("NativeLiuyong").

```{r}
# FoodWeb_ID is kept so IsoFresh fish not in the Liuyong basin list keep their food web after the merge
f_cols_no_dup <- f_cols_no_dup[,c("Taxon","FoodWeb_ID","Country","Longitude","Latitude",
                                  "establishmentMeans_introduced","establishmentMeans_native")]
colnames(cas_ot_fw)[16] <- "Taxon"
cas_ot_fw <- merge(cas_ot_fw, f_cols_no_dup, all = T)

# where Tedesco has no status, fall back to SInAS (rows with no SInAS record stay NA).
# SInAS is by country, so a species can be both native and introduced in the same country
# (moved outside its native range within it); label those "MixedSinas" rather than exotic.
no_tedesco <- is.na(cas_ot_fw$X3.Native.Exotic.Status)
intro <- cas_ot_fw$establishmentMeans_introduced %in% 1
native <- cas_ot_fw$establishmentMeans_native %in% 1
cas_ot_fw$X3.Native.Exotic.Status[no_tedesco & intro & !native] <- "ExoticSinas"
cas_ot_fw$X3.Native.Exotic.Status[no_tedesco & intro & native] <- "MixedSinas"
cas_ot_fw$X3.Native.Exotic.Status[no_tedesco & cas_ot_fw$establishmentMeans_introduced %in% 0] <- "NativeSinas"

# where neither Tedesco nor SInAS has a status, fall back to FishBase country records for the
# food web's country. Only whole-country records (3-digit C_Code) are used, so sub-national
# areas such as Hawaii don't make a species "mixed" for the whole country.
need <- is.na(cas_ot_fw$X3.Native.Exotic.Status)
fb_ctry <- country(unique(cas_ot_fw$Taxon[need])) %>%
  filter(grepl("^[0-9]{3}$", C_Code)) %>%
  left_join(select(fb_tbl("countref"), C_Code, ISO3Alpha), by = "C_Code") %>%
  mutate(st = case_when(Status %in% c("native", "endemic") ~ "native",
                        Status == "introduced" ~ "introduced")) %>%  # skip questionable, not established, etc.
  filter(!is.na(st)) %>%
  group_by(Species, Country_ISO = ISO3Alpha) %>%
  summarise(fb_status = if (n_distinct(st) > 1) "MixedFishBase" else if (st[1] == "native") "NativeFishBase" else "ExoticFishBase",
            .groups = "drop")
fb_st <- fb_ctry$fb_status[match(paste(cas_ot_fw$Taxon, cas_ot_fw$Country_ISO), paste(fb_ctry$Species, fb_ctry$Country_ISO))]
cas_ot_fw$X3.Native.Exotic.Status[need] <- fb_st[need]

# Remaining blanks, step 1: Liuyong lists species for the whole basin, so a species can be native to
# another country sharing the basin but absent from the food web's country. Label those "NativeBasin"
# when FishBase has the species as native in any of the basin's countries.
fb_country_names <- c("Bosnia and Herzegovina" = "Bosnia Herzego.", "Central African Republic" = "Centr. Af. Rp.",
                      "Côte d'Ivoire" = "Ivory coast", "Democratic Republic of the Congo" = "Congo (DR;Kin.)",
                      "México" = "Mexico", "North Korea" = "Korea (North)", "Papua New Guinea" = "Papua New Guin.",
                      "Republic of the Congo" = "Congo (Brazza.)", "South Korea" = "Korea (South)",
                      "South Sudan" = "Sudan (South)", "Sudan" = "Sudan (North)", "Svalbard and Jan Mayen" = "Svalbard Mayen",
                      "Swaziland" = "Eswatini", "Turkey" = "Türkiye", "United Kingdom" = "UK Gr. Britain",
                      "United States" = "US of America", "Vatican City" = "Holy See", "Vietnam" = "Viet Nam")
need <- is.na(cas_ot_fw$X3.Native.Exotic.Status)
basin_ctry <- cas_ot_fw[need, ] %>%
  distinct(Taxon, country) %>%
  mutate(fb_country = country) %>%
  separate_longer_delim(fb_country, ";") %>%
  mutate(fb_country = coalesce(fb_country_names[fb_country], fb_country))
fb_native <- country(unique(basin_ctry$Taxon)) %>%
  filter(Status %in% c("native", "endemic")) %>%
  distinct(Species, country)
native_in_basin <- basin_ctry %>%
  semi_join(fb_native, by = c("Taxon" = "Species", "fb_country" = "country")) %>%
  distinct(Taxon, country)
in_basin <- need & paste(cas_ot_fw$Taxon, cas_ot_fw$country) %in% paste(native_in_basin$Taxon, native_in_basin$country)
cas_ot_fw$X3.Native.Exotic.Status[in_basin] <- "NativeBasin"

# Remaining blanks, step 2: Liuyong species with no FishBase species record (mostly described in the last
# decade). Liuyong's lists come from Catalog of Fishes distributions, which are native ranges, so label
# these "NativeLiuyong" (an assumption, kept as its own label so it can be filtered out).
need <- is.na(cas_ot_fw$X3.Native.Exotic.Status)
no_fb_record <- need & !is.na(cas_ot_fw$class) & !cas_ot_fw$Taxon %in% load_taxa()$Species
cas_ot_fw$X3.Native.Exotic.Status[no_fb_record] <- "NativeLiuyong"

log_adj("Food web kept for IsoFresh fish not on the Liuyong basin list", "IsoFresh fish", "rows",
        sum(is.na(cas_ot_fw$class)))

# One row per food web x species. Duplicates come from Tedesco listing a species in a basin under several
# source names that now resolve to the same Taxon; their differing values are joined with ";". The status
# is the highest-priority one in the group, and a species Tedesco lists as both native and exotic in the
# same basin becomes "MixedTedesco".
status_order <- c("native", "exotic", "ExoticSinas", "MixedSinas", "NativeSinas",
                  "NativeFishBase", "ExoticFishBase", "MixedFishBase", "NativeBasin", "NativeLiuyong")
collapse_status <- function(s) {
  s <- unique(na.omit(s))
  if (all(c("native", "exotic") %in% s)) return("MixedTedesco")
  s[order(match(s, status_order))][1]
}
collapse_values <- function(v) {
  u <- unique(na.omit(v))
  if (length(u) == 0) NA_character_ else paste(u, collapse = ";")
}
n0 <- nrow(cas_ot_fw)
key <- cas_ot_fw[, c("FoodWeb_ID", "Taxon")]
dup <- duplicated(key) | duplicated(key, fromLast = TRUE)
dedup <- cas_ot_fw[dup, ] %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), as.character)) %>%
  group_by(FoodWeb_ID, Taxon) %>%
  summarise(X3.Native.Exotic.Status = collapse_status(X3.Native.Exotic.Status),
            across(-X3.Native.Exotic.Status, collapse_values), .groups = "drop")
cas_ot_fw <- bind_rows(mutate(cas_ot_fw[!dup, ], across(everything(), as.character)), dedup) %>%
  type.convert(as.is = TRUE) %>%           # columns with ";"-joined values stay text
  select(all_of(names(cas_ot_fw))) %>%
  arrange(FoodWeb_ID, Taxon)
log_adj("Duplicate food web x species rows merged", "Combined table", "rows before", n0)
log_adj("Duplicate food web x species rows merged", "Combined table", "rows after", nrow(cas_ot_fw))
log_adj("Duplicate food web x species rows merged", "Combined table", "MixedTedesco pairs",
        sum(cas_ot_fw$X3.Native.Exotic.Status %in% "MixedTedesco"))

# rows, species and food webs per status label
status_counts <- cas_ot_fw %>%
  mutate(X3.Native.Exotic.Status = coalesce(X3.Native.Exotic.Status, "(blank)")) %>%
  group_by(X3.Native.Exotic.Status) %>%
  summarise(rows = n(), species = n_distinct(Taxon), food_webs = n_distinct(FoodWeb_ID))
for (i in seq_len(nrow(status_counts))) {
  for (m in c("rows", "species", "food_webs")) {
    log_adj("Native/exotic status", status_counts$X3.Native.Exotic.Status[i], gsub("_", " ", m), status_counts[[m]][i])
  }
}
st <- cas_ot_fw$X3.Native.Exotic.Status
log_adj("Native/exotic status", "All labels", "species with no status in any row",
        length(setdiff(unique(cas_ot_fw$Taxon[is.na(st)]), unique(cas_ot_fw$Taxon[!is.na(st)]))))

write.csv(cas_ot_fw,"FW_species_richness_nat_exotic_Sinas_Tedesco.csv", row.names = FALSE, na = "")
```

Species richness per food web, two ways: with all species in the food web's Liuyong basin, and without "NativeBasin" species (native elsewhere in the basin but not recorded in the food web's country). Each species counts once per food web; MixedTedesco, MixedSinas and MixedFishBase count as mixed.

```{r}
fw_richness <- function(d) {
  d %>%
    filter(!is.na(FoodWeb_ID)) %>%
    mutate(cls = case_when(grepl("^(exotic|Exotic)", X3.Native.Exotic.Status) ~ "exotic",
                           grepl("^Mixed", X3.Native.Exotic.Status) ~ "mixed",
                           grepl("^(native|Native)", X3.Native.Exotic.Status) ~ "native",
                           TRUE ~ "unknown")) %>%
    group_by(FoodWeb_ID, Taxon) %>%
    summarise(cls = if (n_distinct(cls) > 1 && all(c("native", "exotic") %in% cls)) "mixed" else first(cls),
              .groups = "drop") %>%
    count(FoodWeb_ID, cls) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = cls, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
    mutate(total = rowSums(across(any_of(c("native", "exotic", "mixed", "unknown"))))) %>%
    select(FoodWeb_ID, total, any_of(c("native", "exotic", "mixed", "unknown")))
}

cas_ot_fw_country <- subset(cas_ot_fw, !X3.Native.Exotic.Status %in% "NativeBasin")
write.csv(cas_ot_fw_country, "FW_species_richness_nat_exotic_Sinas_Tedesco_no_NativeBasin.csv", row.names = FALSE, na = "")

rich_basin <- fw_richness(cas_ot_fw)
rich_country <- fw_richness(cas_ot_fw_country)
write.csv(rich_basin, "FW_richness_basin.csv", row.names = FALSE, na = "")
write.csv(rich_country, "FW_richness_country.csv", row.names = FALSE, na = "")

log_adj("Richness without NativeBasin species", "Combined table", "rows removed", nrow(cas_ot_fw) - nrow(cas_ot_fw_country))
for (v in list(list("Richness: basin version", rich_basin), list("Richness: country version", rich_country))) {
  r <- v[[2]]
  log_adj(v[[1]], "Food webs", "food webs", nrow(r))
  log_adj(v[[1]], "Food webs", "median species per food web", median(r$total))
  log_adj(v[[1]], "Food webs", "mean species per food web", round(mean(r$total), 1))
  for (cl in c("native", "exotic", "mixed", "unknown")) {
    log_adj(v[[1]], "Food webs", paste(cl, "species, summed over food webs"), if (cl %in% names(r)) sum(r[[cl]]) else 0)
  }
}
```

From the IsoFresh database:
Boulêtreau, S., Vagnon, C., Comte, L., Sagouis, A., Pool, T., Stiling, R.R., Harrod, C., South, J., McIntosh, A.R., Perga, M.E. and Sánchez-Hernández, J., 2025. IsoFresh: A global stable isotope database of freshwater food webs. Knowledge & Management of Aquatic Ecosystems, (426), p.15. https://www.kmae-journal.org/articles/kmae/full_html/2025/01/kmae250024/kmae250024.html

Bring in other species with isotopic data from this database. Restrict to taxa that are described to species: trim to the first two words (as with SInAS), and drop "Genus sp."-type names, family-level names, and descriptive second words ("adult", "larvae", "and", ...).

```{r}
stop_words <- c("sp", "spp", "cf", "aff", "adult", "adults", "larva", "larvae",
                "juvenile", "juveniles", "and", "or", "snail")
oth <- read_isofresh("IsoFresh_Isotope_Other.csv") %>%
  mutate(Scientific_name = word(str_squish(Scientific_name), 1, 2)) %>%
  filter(
    str_detect(Scientific_name, "^[A-Z][a-z]+ [a-z]+$"),   # "Genus species" only
    !word(Scientific_name, 2) %in% stop_words,
    !str_detect(word(Scientific_name, 1), "idae$")          # family names
  )
```

Update other taxon names to the GBIF accepted species.

```{r}
oth$Scientific_name <- gbif_valid(oth$Scientific_name, "IsoFresh other taxa")
```

Bring in ecosystem data from the same database which includes coordinates.

```{r}
eco <- read_isofresh("IsoFresh_Ecosystem.csv")
eco <- eco[which(!is.na(eco$Longitude)),]
```

Join invert or other observation to ecosystem and point location using FoodWeb_ID as the join field.

```{r}
oth_eco <- merge(oth, eco, by = "FoodWeb_ID", all.x = TRUE)
```

Convert fish_eco to an sf object.

```{r}
o_sf <- st_as_sf(oth_eco, coords = c("Longitude", "Latitude"), crs = 4326, remove = FALSE)
```

Do spatial join to get country for each of the IsoFresh locations, copy f_sf column Scientific_name to a column called "Taxon", and drop geometry.

```{r}
o_sf <- st_join(o_sf, gdf, join = st_nearest_feature)
o_db <- st_drop_geometry(o_sf)
o_db$Taxon <- o_db$Scientific_name
```

Join SInAS to IsoFresh by "Scientific_name" and "location" columns.

```{r}
o_sfs <- merge(o_sf, sinas, by = c("Scientific_name","location","locationID"))
o_sfs <- st_drop_geometry(o_sfs)
write.csv(o_sfs,"fw_inverts.csv", row.names = FALSE, na = "")
```

Write the summary of every adjustment made above (name updates, duplicates removed, status sources, richness).

```{r}
write.csv(adjustments, "adjustments_summary.csv", row.names = FALSE, na = "")
```

```{r}
save.image("fw.Rdata")
```
